answer: Hold surprise roll calls. At random, unannounced moments the ledger hands every identity a fresh reasoning task due in 90 seconds, all at once. One honest agent answers easily; an operator steering fifty aliases through one GPU or one API quota hits a summit of simultaneous demand, and most aliases time out and forfeit that epoch's pay. A farm must buy peak capacity per alias, not share average capacity, and an idle alias kept as a relic gets cut. Like a lotus opening for each sunrise, presence can't be banked. Assumption: calls stay rare enough to be cheap for honest bots.
